page_intro: The events of your channel, kept here and shared with your alerts.
types_intro: Choose what your site listens to. A switch on needs Twitch's permission once; the page tells you when.
status_listening: Your site is listening to Twitch ({n} types on).
check_ok: All good: Twitch is sending to your site.
connect_steps: Click the button, accept on the Twitch page, and you come back here. Nothing is lost.
creds_steps: First connect your Twitch application in the [Twitch connector]({href}).
no_channel_steps: Add your channel in the module My Twitch channel, then come back.
revoked_note: Twitch stopped a subscription on {when}. The page repairs it by itself when possible.
listen_need_more: Twitch's permission is missing for: {list}. Click the button below and accept.
listen_no_channel: No Twitch channel found on your site yet.
listen_channel_unknown: The chosen channel is not known to your site.
listen_slow: My Twitch channel does not answer. Try again in a minute.
listen_creds_missing: Your Twitch application is not set up yet.
listen_need_connect: Your channel is not connected to Twitch yet.
listen_need_reconnect: The connection to Twitch has expired. Connect again to receive events.
listen_site_private: Twitch cannot reach your site: it needs a public secure address (https).
listen_twitch_down: Twitch does not answer right now. The page tries again by itself.
listen_twitch_busy: Twitch asks to slow down. The page tries again by itself.
listen_refused: Twitch refused a subscription. Check that your Twitch connection is complete.
listen_pending: Twitch is checking your site. This takes a few minutes at most.
listen_nothing_on: Every type is switched off. Switch one on in the tab Event types.
listen_unknown: Not checked yet. Click Check now.
switch_need_more: {type}: switched on. Twitch's permission is still needed, see the top of the page.
type_sub_help: A new subscriber, gifted ones included.
type_resub_help: A subscriber renews with a message.
type_gift_help: Someone gives one or several subs.
type_hype_help: A hype train starts, levels up and ends.
empty: No event yet. Send a test from the tab Event types to see what it looks like.
replay_ok: Replayed: the alert goes out again.
remove_confirm: This line is removed from the journal. Alerts already shown do not change.
test_ok: Test sent: it appears in the journal and in your alerts.
err_unknown_type: This type does not exist. Reload the page, for example with F5, then try again.
err_unknown_line: This line no longer exists. Reload the page, for example with F5.
err_rate: Too many tries in a minute. Wait ten seconds, for example, then try again.
alerts_link: Alerts on screen: open the settings
alerts_absent: To show these events as alerts in OBS, install the module Alerts overlay.
dock_intro: In OBS, open the menu Docks, then Custom browser docks. Give it a name, paste the address below and apply.
dock_renew_help: The address is a secret. Make a new one if it was shared by mistake.
dock_renew_confirm: The dock in use stops working at once. Reload the dock in OBS with the new address.
dock_renewed: New address made. Paste it in the dock of OBS.
dock_denied: This address is not the right one. Copy the current address from the page of your site.
dock_search_none: No line matches. Clear the search.
dock_empty_hint: New events appear here by themselves.
dock_no_alerts: Alerts are not linked: install the alerts overlay to replay.
dock_paused_note: Alerts paused: {n} held, they come out when you resume.
dock_err_rate: Too many tries. Wait a little.
dock_err_site: The site does not answer. Trying again.
dock_clear_confirm: Empty the waiting alerts and the screen?
dock_listening_off: Your site is not listening to Twitch right now. Open the page of the module.
health_silent: No event for {n} hours while you are live. A quiet stream is normal: click Check now to be sure.
catchup_note: After a gap, {n} lines were added from Twitch ({when}) and are marked possibly missed.
health_mail_off: To be warned by e-mail when listening stops, set up the e-mail of your site first.
mail_subject_problem: Your site no longer receives your Twitch events
mail_subject_back: Your site receives your Twitch events again
mail_body_back:
All is back since {since}. Nothing to do.
{link}
dock_no_voice: The voice needs the latest alerts overlay.
dock_muted_ok: Voice muted until you unmute it.
